verdict.rationale: Stripe's sandbox docs tell coding agents to run `stripe sandbox create` from the Stripe CLI, which provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and needs no account registration. That gives agents an isolated environment away from production. The MPP docs add an end-to-end conformance test (`mppx validate`) and a test-payment path through Link CLI. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that private-preview ACS checkout and shared payment token flows run in sandboxes, documentation of how sandbox data is kept separate from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration that sandbox provisioning works.
